# routeros_certificate_crl (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The URL the CRL is downloaded from.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>

### Read-Only

- `akid` (String) The authority key identifier of the CRL issuer.
- `cert` (String) The name of the certificate this CRL belongs to.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the downloaded CRL is past its `next_update` time.
- `fingerprint` (String) The fingerprint of the downloaded CRL.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)
- `last_update` (String) The `thisUpdate` time of the downloaded CRL.
- `next_update` (String) The `nextUpdate` time of the downloaded CRL.
- `num` (String) The number of entries in the downloaded CRL.
- `revoked` (String) The revocation status determined from this CRL.
- `signature` (String) The signature algorithm of the downloaded CRL.
- `trust_store` (String) The trust store the certificate that references this CRL belongs to.
